hypotheses.reasoning: search-api v4.29.0 was rolled out at 21:09:17 (#1600) replacing v4.28.7, and it was started at 21:09:38 (#1650). The template-svc MAILER_API_KEY rotation (#1608, 401s at #1668/#1791) breaks email notifications only, not /search. Recommended: roll back search-api to v4.28.7, then fix product-formatter.ts line 74 to handle products with a missing region before re-deploying.
